title: Investigating Variation in Replicability: A 'Many Labs' Replication Project
overview: Replicability of 13 effects tested across 36 independent samples totaling 6,344 participants; aggregate and site-level moderation by lab versus online and US versus international.

readiness.scope: Studies s01–s08 and s11 can be run as text. s09 and s10 (image manipulations) and s12 (reaction-time IAT) are excluded until the researcher decides how to handle them.
